summary.intent: Plan GSD phase 70.1 (rotation read-plane durability and deep crash-resume soundness) by grounding a planner agent in prior SQ7 research and generating the phase's implementation plans.
summary.outcome: Spawned an opus-based planner with explicit wave-sequencing and phase-split-recommendation permissions; it produced 13 PLAN.md files plus a ROADMAP.md update under .planning/phases/70.1-rotation-read-plane-durability-and-deep-crash-resume-soundne/.

repo: RotationDeps adapter for crash-resume/rotation work belongs in a new crates/fuse/src/write_ops/rotation_deps.rs, sourcing api/owner-keypair/rt from CipherBoxFS.
SQ7 research maps every RotationDeps method to an existing primitive except a new key-checkpoint seam, making the phase mostly an assembly job rather than new design.
workflow: GSD planner can be given explicit wave-sequencing directives (e.g., 'D-17: live-wiring after engine soundness') for multi-surface phases, and explicit permission to emit '## PHASE SPLIT RECOMMENDED' if the phase exceeds budget.
When existing research (SQ7) already covers the relevant surface, a redundant pattern-mapper re-run can be skipped and the planner pointed directly at the research doc.

open_items: 13 generated PLAN.md files (70.1-01 through 70.1-13) for phase 70.1 still need review/execution.
Planner had the option to flag '## PHASE SPLIT RECOMMENDED' — outcome of that check not shown in transcript and should be confirmed.
